lines: I still remember that {attack_weapon}. Conversations get colder after that.
It is hard to speak plainly while remembering that {attack_weapon}.
That {attack_weapon} stayed in my memory longer than the bruise did.
You may be done with that moment, but I am not.
Trust does not stand as close after a hit like that.
I hear your words, but I remember your hands.
That {attack_weapon} made a simple conversation feel less simple.
I am trying to answer you without forgetting why I am careful.
Some wounds fade faster than the caution they leave behind.
If I seem distant, that {attack_weapon} is part of the reason.
The bell has been quiet today. I would like to keep it that way.
Quiet bells are good bells. Let us not give this one a reason.
Today has been calm so far. I am protective of that.
A quiet morning is worth guarding.
No alarms yet today. I am hoping it stays that simple.
The square feels steady today. That is a welcome thing.
If the bell stays silent, I will call that a good day.
Peace has been keeping its voice down. I appreciate that.
The village is breathing easy for now.
A calm day can be rare enough to treat kindly.
